Vorbis: https://github.com/krkrz/wuvorbis
Pinned commit: 7566c57c1cdd095846389cf74b66170988dd22cd
Complete WuVorbisMainUnit.cpp inspected. Original credit:
"OggVorbis Plug-in for TVP Sound System (C) 2000 W.Dee <dee@kikyou.info>".

These references establish module exports, sample position/time semantics,
codec/extension names and optional gain/output configuration. No original
COM/Win32, libopus/libvorbis C/C++, SDK, mixer or renderer implementation is
embedded or copied. The adapter validates the engine's decoder capability,
then uses the existing engine-owned worker/resource/AudioRequest path.
CrySirror's existing pure-Rust Opus decoder and Symphonia Vorbis decoder retain
their own notices. Non-default native codec options fail explicitly; source
ReplayGain metadata is exposed by shared AudioResourceInfo and native playback
fails visibly where the original Vorbis module would apply it.
